notes: Battery polarity on JST PH is not standardised. Adafruit, SparkFun and Particle batteries share one convention: on the battery's plug, latch bump up and holes facing you, + (red) is on the right. Many other LiPo cells are wired the other way: measure the battery and print + and - beside the header before routing.
Connect the cell's + net to the contact it lands on, the other to GND; name the nets (VBAT, GND) rather than relying on the contact numbers.
Rated 2 A (AWG 24): enough for single-cell LiPo packs up to about 2 A discharge.
Mated height 8 mm; the plug enters from above.
